stop_resume_policy: Any hard-budget breach or failed world-arm stops scheduling; running jobs finish; RUN_STATUS.json records the actual error and committed count.
Resume only uncommitted world-arms, under the same verified SOURCE_LOCK; never rerun, overwrite or replace a committed receipt; no replacement worlds or reduced roster.
A scientific integrity failure (audit, lock, birth, dose-yoke ZDoseNotRepresentable) is reported, not retried automatically.

Host constraint: the cloud VM computes only while a tool call is executing and the container is reclaimed when idle, so execution needs continuous blocking waits across sessions; receipts are pushed every 16.
